attchmntText: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited
voiceSummary: R M Drip And Sprinklers Systems Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 09th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 7,256.23 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 995.13 lakhs. Profit for the period was 734.61 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.17. Total assets were 20,844.36 lakhs. Equity share capital was 4,282.08 lakhs. The company will publish an extract of the results with a QR code on its website.
